correctness.rationale: The attached exhaustive exact verifier reconstructs the graph and all 10,870 faces, the five critical Morse cells and the acyclic orientation on all 63,780 incidences, proving rational homology only in degree seven of rank four. It separately evaluates orbit-union traces and oriented fixed-face traces for each of 120 S5 permutations; both equal fixed-label count minus one. The signed augmented Lefschetz identity and character theory give the stated S5 module.

originality.rationale: Searches and source comparisons distinguish the new complete S5 character of a bounded-degree Petersen two-matching complex from the already published four-sphere wedge count, from higher matching complexes of complete graphs and hypergraphs, from different Petersen cut/configuration complexes, and from clique-free shellability theory. No known result inspected implies the character; an unindexed equivalent remains possible.
residual_risks: An unindexed paper or private computation might already contain the same exact character, which a finite search cannot rule out.
The strongest primary materials were inspected for relevant claims, not asserted to be a complete line-by-line audit of every publication.

value.rationale: Determining the exact S5 module of a highly symmetric 4-dimensional top homology is nontrivial: the known wedge of four spheres leaves multiple inequivalent possible actions, notably sign-twisted standard. The complete character determines full invariants, establishes the untwisted irreducible type and provides a natural equivariant benchmark within a new clique-free-complex setting.
